label: Couchbase Server 7.6
note: Round 14 removed two aliases and rewrote the 14 records that used them. version:server-7.6 was a punctuation variant of this id and version:couchbase-server-7.6 a long-form spelling of the same release, and aliasing them was the wrong half of the alias-or-rewrite rule: it made the corpus pass the gate while leaving the next dotted mint looking correct, and it hid both forms from recurrence.py --variants, which resolves aliases before clustering and so reported no variant at all. One release, one id, dashes; enforced by normalise-ids.py's version rule going forward and by verify-registry-ids.py's rejection of punctuation-variant aliases.
